# LibreOffice Writer Mail Merge Dialog: "Select Starting Document"

## Window Title and Context
- **Window Title**: `blackmail_template.odt - LibreOffice Writer`
- **Application**: LibreOffice Writer
- **Date and Time**: `Oct 23 17:25`
- **System Tray**: Bell icon visible in top-right corner
- **Desktop Environment**: Linux (indicated by "Activities" in top-left and application dock on left)

## Application Interface Overview
- **Top Menu Bar**: Contains standard menu items: `File`, `Edit`, `View`, `Insert`, `Format`, `Styles`, `Table`, `Form`, `Tools`, `Window`, `Help`
- **Toolbar**: Located below the menu bar, contains icons for common functions such as:
  - File operations (New, Open, Save, Print)
  - Text formatting (Bold, Italic, Underline, Strikethrough)
  - Font selection (currently set to `Arial`, size `11 pt`)
  - Paragraph formatting (alignment, lists, indentation)
  - Drawing tools (shapes, lines, pen)
- **Status Bar**: Located at the bottom of the window, displays:
  - Page information: `Page 1 of 1`
  - Word and character count: `49 words, 325 characters`
  - Page style: `Default Page Style`
  - Language: `English (en)`
  - Zoom level: `100%`
- **Sidebar (Left)**: Application dock with icons for:
  - Web browser (Chrome)
  - Email client (Thunderbird)
  - Code editor (Visual Studio Code)
  - Media player (VLC)
  - LibreOffice applications (Writer, Calc, Impress, Draw)
  - System utilities (File manager, Terminal, Help, Trash)

## Dialog Box: "Select Starting Document"
- **Title**: `Select Starting Document`
- **Position**: Centered over the main LibreOffice Writer document
- **Purpose**: Configures the starting document for a mail merge operation

### Left Navigation Panel
- **Current Selection**: `Select Starting Document` (highlighted in gray)
- **Other Options**:
  - `Select Document Type`
  - `Insert Address Block`
  - `Create Salutation`
  - `Adjust Layout`

### Right Content Panel
- **Section Title**: `Select Starting Document for the Mail Merge`
- **Options**:
  - `Use the current document` (selected, indicated by a red circle)
  - `Exchange Database...` (button)
  - `Create a new document` (radio button, unselected)
  - `Start from existing document` (radio button, unselected)
    - `Browse...` (button)
  - `Start from a template` (radio button, unselected)
    - `Browse...` (button)
  - `Start from a recently saved starting document` (radio button, unselected)
    - Dropdown menu (currently empty)

### Bottom Action Buttons
- `Help` (button)
- `< Back` (button)
- `Next >` (button)
- `Cancel` (button)
- `Finish` (button)

## Additional UI Elements
- **Top Banner**: Two informational banners:
  - `Help us make LibreOffice even better!`
  - `Your donations support our worldwide community.`
  - Two buttons: `Get involved` and `Donate`
- **Right Sidebar (Vertical)**: Contains icons for:
  - Drawing tools
  - Styles
  - Navigator
  - Document properties
  - Spelling and grammar checker
- **Window Controls**: Minimize, maximize, close buttons in top-right corner of the dialog

## Document State
- **Document Name**: `blackmail_template.odt`
- **Document Content**: Not visible, as the dialog is in focus
- **Document Statistics**: 49 words, 325 characters
- **Document Style**: Default Page Style
- **Document Language**: English (en)
